question: What's new this week in Agentic AI hiring trends and in tooling/frameworks worth knowing about?

what_to_study.summary: Baize – an open‑source CLI “AI coding‑agent” supporting multiple LLM back‑ends, tool‑calling, sub‑agent delegation, and sandboxed execution
design‑studio‑ai – a cloud‑based workspace that blends AI agents with human designers, offering multimodal control panels and BYOK LLM integration
ValuationAnalyst – lightweight framework for financial‑valuation agents (market‑data retrieval, ratio analysis, report generation)
Agentic‑AI‑Based‑Multi‑Source‑Data‑Retrieval‑and‑Stakeholder‑Intelligence‑Platform – orchestrates API, DB, and file‑system calls to produce stakeholder‑focused intelligence

what_to_share_with_learners.summary: Agentic‑AI job postings have surged ≈280% YTD, indicating a shift from pilots to production‑grade deployments
what_to_share_with_learners.source_note: F5 Hiring Solutions (2026‑07‑31), corroborated by multiple other postings

what_to_share_with_learners.summary: Compensation splits into two bands: hourly contracts $45‑$112 /hr for rapid‑prototype work; full‑time senior roles $84k‑$135k base (plus bonuses); top‑tier senior talent $185k‑$320k base
what_to_share_with_learners.source_note: ZipRecruiter (hourly & full‑time listings), KORE1 salary survey

what_to_share_with_learners.summary: Companies hire remote talent in cost‑effective regions (e.g., India $600 /week) while posting high‑salary senior roles in North America/Europe
Surveys describe a thin talent pool and a seller’s market for experienced Agentic‑AI engineers
New titles such as Agentic AI Engineer, Agentic AI Developer, AI‑Agent Product Manager, Automation Architect are appearing

In‑demand skill clusters include intelligent workflow design, AI‑agent development & deployment, automation/orchestration frameworks, rapid prototyping, full‑stack engineering, and business‑impact measurement

digest.linkedin_post_draft: 🚀 **Agentic AI hiring is exploding!** In just the past few months, advertised Agentic‑AI roles have jumped ~280 % year‑to‑date – a clear signal that companies are moving from experimental pilots to full‑scale production. 📈 Salaries reflect the rush: senior engineers are now commanding $185 k‑$320 k base, while contract talent can earn $45‑$112 /hr for rapid‑prototype projects. 🌍 Remote‑first hiring is also reshaping the talent map, with firms tapping skilled engineers worldwide (e.g., remote teams in India) while still offering premium packages for senior talent in North America and Europe. If you’re an engineer who can design, build, and ship autonomous agents that drive measurable business impact, now is the moment to position yourself at the forefront of this booming market.

training_module_ideas.topic: End‑to‑End Agentic AI Development for Business Workflows
training_module_ideas.learning_objective: Learners will be able to design, build, test, and deploy a production‑grade autonomous agent that automates a multi‑step business workflow and measures its impact.
key_points: Implement agent logic using rapid‑prototype techniques
Deploy the agent to a cloud environment
Set up metrics to evaluate business impact

training_module_ideas.topic: Navigating the Agentic AI Job Market: Roles, Compensation, and Career Paths
training_module_ideas.learning_objective: Learners will be able to map emerging Agentic AI job titles to compensation bands and craft strategies to succeed in a seller’s‑market environment.
key_points: Identify emerging role taxonomy (Engineer, Developer, Product Manager, Automation Architect)
Understand the two compensation bands (hourly vs. senior salary)
Analyze geographic hiring trends and remote‑first strategies
Develop personal branding and negotiation tactics for a thin talent pool
training_module_ideas.based_on: Hiring volume; Compensation split; Geographic flexibility; Talent shortage / seller’s market; Emerging role taxonomy

training_module_ideas.topic: Hands‑On with Emerging Agentic AI Tooling
training_module_ideas.learning_objective: Learners will gain practical experience with the latest open‑source Agentic AI tools and frameworks to accelerate prototype development.
key_points: Explore Baize CLI for terminal‑based AI coding assistance
Create collaborative agents using design‑studio‑ai’s multimodal workspace
Build a domain‑specific agent with ValuationAnalyst
Experiment with a multi‑source data‑retrieval platform for stakeholder intelligence
training_module_ideas.based_on: Tool‑centric CLI agents; Collaborative design agents; Domain‑specific agent frameworks; Multi‑source data‑retrieval platform
